label: Brc113 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a gcu113/Brc113 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: Brc113 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Brc113 proteins, brc113 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, absent source database rows naming gcu113, absent DefenseFinder HMM/rules profiles, broad BRiC families, and other mobile integron phage-defense cassettes.
